title: Finished coffee stock valuation
requirements: Return a JSON-compatible dict with cases and bags, each the corresponding stock count times its selling price rounded to two decimal places; total is their sum rounded to two places. Use Decimal arithmetic before converting to floats. Zero stock gives 0.0. Do not change existing prices or quantities.

title: Finished coffee restock signals
requirements: Return a boolean: active products need restock when cases_in_stock < 5 OR bags_in_stock < 10. Equality is sufficient stock. Inactive products always return false. Keep the thresholds fixed for this workload.

title: Green coffee remaining stock value
requirements: Return weight_kg_remaining times cost_per_kg_usd as a float rounded to two decimal places using Decimal arithmetic. Zero remaining weight gives 0.0. Do not change the existing is_low behavior.

title: Roast weight loss reporting
requirements: Return (green_weight_kg - roasted_weight_kg) / green_weight_kg * 100 rounded to one decimal place. Return None if green weight is zero or roasted weight is None. A recorded roasted weight of zero means 100.0 percent loss. Do not change yield_pct.

title: Order shipment coverage
requirements: Return a dict with ordered_quantity (sum of item quantities), allocated_quantity (sum of cases on delivery_truck shipments only, treating None as zero), and unallocated_quantity (max(ordered minus allocated, 0)). Quantities are integers. All shipments count regardless of status; parcel shipments do not contribute. Empty orders produce three zeros. Preserve existing order fields.

title: Order days overdue
requirements: Return an integer max((date.today() - due_date).days, 0) for orders with a due date unless status is delivered or cancelled. Return zero for those terminal statuses or missing due dates. Compute dynamically on each access. Preserve is_overdue.

title: Customer delivered revenue
requirements: Return the sum of quantity times unit_price for items in delivered orders only, rounded to two decimal places as a float. Calculate with Decimal arithmetic. Exclude all other statuses. No delivered orders returns 0.0; compute from current relationships rather than storing a column.

title: Customer active subscription quantities
requirements: Return the integer sum of quantity across active subscriptions only. Paused and cancelled subscriptions contribute zero; frequency and product do not affect this raw quantity count. No subscriptions returns zero.

title: Truck shipment capacity utilization
requirements: For delivery_truck shipments with an assigned trucking service having capacity_cases > 0 and cases not None, return cases / capacity_cases * 100 rounded to one decimal place. Return None otherwise, including parcels with a trucking service assigned. Zero cases gives 0.0 and overcapacity may exceed 100.0.

title: Subscription normalized monthly demand
requirements: Return active subscription quantity normalized to a month: weekly quantity * 52 / 12, biweekly quantity * 26 / 12, monthly quantity unchanged. Round to two decimal places as a float. Paused/cancelled or an unknown frequency return 0.0. Do not change frequency/status transitions.
